title: Psionic asset recruited through the GATE program

tellings.quote: interviewed yesterday a psionic asset who was recruited through the gate program

plain: A person with claimed psychic powers, whom insiders call a "psionic asset", was said to have been recruited for government work through GATE, a school programme for gifted and talented children. Michels says this himself, mentioning that he "interviewed yesterday a psionic asset who was recruited through the gate program." If true, it would mean children's gifted programmes were used to find psychics.
